title: Kestrel and the Quiet Moonshade Survey
description: A little midnight-blue lunar survey buggy and his tiny marker-cart friend place glowing markers along cool moonshadows, then rest calmly beneath the stars.

Kestrel.role: Main character; a little lunar survey buggy
Kestrel.color: Rounded midnight-blue body with a pearl-white roof canopy and pale-silver crescent emblems on each side
Kestrel.bodyShape: Small lunar survey buggy with a short silver equipment deck at the rear, four wide dusty-gray moon tires, two slim antenna rods, and one small amber beacon on top; no arms or hands
Kestrel.face: Exactly two calm amber eyes located in the two front headlights; no windshield eyes and nothing else resembling eyes; friendly narrow grille smile
Kestrel.accessories: Tiny sensor on the equipment deck; no lettering, logos, or numbers

Ivo.role: Supporting character; a tiny lunar marker cart
Ivo.color: Compact apricot-orange body with a cream top
Ivo.bodyShape: Much smaller than Kestrel, with four small charcoal wheels and a shallow rear tray for glowing markers; no arms or hands
Ivo.face: Exactly two soft teal eyes located in the two front headlights; no windshield eyes and no other eye-like lights; small grille smile
Ivo.accessories: Shallow tray carrying glowing moon markers

settingBible.Lunar Research Valley: A peaceful lunar valley with powdery silver ground, rounded craters, low blue-gray ridges, a distant observatory dome with warm golden windows, small blue Earth on the horizon, and glowing markers along cool moonshadows
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded space vehicles, pale lunar evening fading to deep quiet night, one scene per page, and no readable text on story pages

continuityRules: Kestrel keeps midnight-blue body, pearl-white canopy, crescent emblems, and eyes only in the two headlights.
Ivo stays a much smaller apricot-orange marker cart with cream top and eyes only in the two headlights.
Narration calls the markers glowing markers rather than flat reflective ones.
Soft marker-count wording where exact counts may not match the art.
Page 15 keeps Kestrel and Ivo calm at bedtime.
No rescue, danger, lettering, logos, or numerals in artwork.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words on story-page artwork.

pages.text: Kestrel rolled out from the observatory as the lunar valley grew quiet.
pages.illustrationScene: Midnight-blue lunar survey buggy Kestrel rolls slowly away from a warmly lit observatory into a peaceful silver valley beneath stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Kestrel alone on page 1; Ivo absent. Headlight eyes only.

pages.text: Ivo followed with glowing markers tucked neatly in his little tray.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiny apricot marker cart Ivo follows Kestrel along the moon trail with glowing markers neat in his shallow rear tray.
pages.continuityNotes: Call markers glowing markers, not flat reflective ones. Soft count wording.

pages.text: Their evening job was to find the coolest moonshadows along the observatory trail.
pages.illustrationScene: Kestrel and Ivo pause at the beginning of the survey trail, looking toward long soft shadows cast by distant ridges.

pages.text: Kestrel paused beside a tall ridge where one long shadow stretched across the dust.
pages.illustrationScene: Kestrel stops beside a tall blue-gray lunar ridge casting one long gentle shadow across the silver ground, with Ivo waiting behind.
pages.continuityNotes: First cool shadow found beside ridge.

pages.text: His tiny sensor blinked softly. Cool and calm, said Kestrel. This is a good spot.
pages.illustrationScene: Close-medium view of Kestrel calmly examining shaded ground with a tiny softly glowing sensor while Ivo watches nearby.
pages.continuityNotes: Calm sensor check; no dramatic machinery.

pages.text: Ivo placed the first glowing marker beside the shadow, where moonlight could still touch it.
pages.illustrationScene: Ivo places a glowing marker at the edge of the cool shadow where moonlight touches it; Kestrel watches approvingly.
pages.continuityNotes: Glowing marker wording, not flat reflective.

pages.text: They found another cool patch beside a round crater and another beneath a low stone arch.
pages.illustrationScene: Wide lunar view of Kestrel and Ivo near a round crater and low stone arch with cool shadow spots and a few glowing markers behind them.
pages.continuityNotes: More cool shadow spots; soft marker wording.

pages.text: Soon a few little glowing markers shimmered behind them like quiet silver breadcrumbs.
pages.illustrationScene: Kestrel and Ivo continue forward while a few glowing markers shimmer in a gentle curved line behind them.
pages.continuityNotes: Soft marker count; glowing markers not flat reflective.

pages.text: Farther ahead, the trail crossed a wide open plain, but almost no shadow waited there.
pages.illustrationScene: Kestrel and Ivo reach a wide open lunar plain with almost no shadows, pausing thoughtfully beneath a huge open star field.
pages.continuityNotes: Small quiet problem: almost no shadow on the plain.

pages.text: Kestrel climbed a gentle rise and spotted a small ridge casting a soft crescent shade.
pages.illustrationScene: Kestrel climbs a gentle lunar rise and looks toward a small ridge casting a soft crescent-shaped shadow below, with Ivo following.

pages.text: Ivo set down more glowing markers while Earth glowed blue above the horizon.
pages.illustrationScene: Ivo sets down more glowing markers near cool shadows while Kestrel watches and small blue Earth glows on the horizon.
pages.timeOfDay: deep lunar night with Earth glow

pages.text: The final cool shadow waited beside the observatory's old moon rock garden.
pages.illustrationScene: Kestrel and Ivo arrive beside an old moon rock garden of smooth rounded stones near the observatory, where one final soft shadow waits.
pages.continuityNotes: Final cool shadow near moon rock garden.

pages.text: Together the glowing markers formed a peaceful path through the lunar valley.
pages.illustrationScene: Wide peaceful view of glowing markers forming a soft path through the lunar valley, with Kestrel and Ivo admiring their work.
pages.continuityNotes: Glowing markers path; soft count wording.

pages.text: Kestrel and Ivo followed the soft glows home as the observatory windows grew warm and golden.
pages.illustrationScene: Kestrel and Ivo travel home along the gently glowing marker path toward the observatory's warm golden windows under a deep night sky.

pages.text: They parked calmly beneath the stars, and Kestrel whispered goodnight to the quiet moonshadows.
pages.illustrationScene: Kestrel and Ivo rest calmly parked beneath the stars near the quiet lunar valley, eyes gentle and peaceful.
pages.continuityNotes: Calm bedtime ending for Kestrel and Ivo.
